name: TTO_W2_4_DURABLE_SYNTHETIC_SECURITY_AUDIT_CHAIN

storage.implementation: Node fs promises; a runner-local temporary directory, single writer; not a service database
storage.mode: append-only journal inside a single-writer process; no remote replicas
storage.journaling: append newline JSON, fsync event file, then fsync a new checkpoint and atomic rename, fsync directory
storage.checkpoint: separate JSON counter and head SHA256 digest, updated after each event
storage.crashModel: a torn event or event/checkpoint mismatch fails closed until independently resolved
storage.exclusivity: lock file created with wx; never silently steal a stale lock
storage.restarts: close and re-open within same isolated runner test; files removed after test
storage.securityNote: SHA256 without independent external trusted anchor/signature detects naive single-file tampering and corruption, not an adversary who controls both journal and checkpoint

eventSchema.requestId: UUIDv4-or-valid UUID generated by synthetic BFF; no actual user/Party IDs
eventSchema.hashMaterial: SHA256(prevHash + newline + canonical JSON of eight non-hash event fields); genesis 64 zeros
eventSchema.timestamp: ISO8601 UTC from server; ordering authority is sequence, not wall clock
perRequestRequiredSequences: BFF_PREFLIGHT: CANDIDATE -> NEST_SCOPE: DENY -> BFF_RESPONSE: DENY
BFF_PREFLIGHT: CANDIDATE -> NEST_SCOPE: CANDIDATE -> PDP_RESULT: DENY or SIMULATED_ONLY -> BFF_RESPONSE: DENY
eventSchema.defaultPublicResponse: Always 403/503 unavailable/denied, never HTTP 200 or data

deferredBeforeProduction: independently approved operational audit storage and retention policy
cross-process/distributed durable single-writer or transaction log
external immutable anchor/signatures and key rotation
source access SQL/physical touch evidence and RLS
crash recovery and locked-writer administrative playbooks
security approval, full release checks and explicit user merge/deploy permission
official source admissibility and governance approvals
